#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int T = 1;
    const long long M = 1000000007;

    for (int _ = 0; _ < T; ++_) {
        int P, K;
        cin >> P >> K;

        vector<long long> k(P);
        for (int x = 0; x < P; ++x) {
            k[x] = (long long)K * x % P;
        }

        if (K == 0) {
            // pow(P, P - 1, M)
            long long result = 1;
            long long base = P % M;
            long long exp = P - 1;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % M;
                base = (base * base) % M;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            cout << result << "\n";
            continue;
        }

        vector<int> f(P, 0);
        vector<int> c(P, 0);
        long long ans = 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < P; ++i) {
            if (f[i]) continue;
            int cnt = 1;
            int u = i;
            f[u] = 1;
            while (!f[k[u]]) {
                u = (int)k[u];
                f[u] = 1;
                cnt++;
            }
            c[cnt]++;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < P; ++i) {
            if (c[i] != 0) {
                long long cnt = (long long)i * c[i];
                if (i > 1) {
                    cnt += c[1];
                }
                // pow(cnt, c[i], M)
                long long base = cnt % M;
                long long exp = c[i];
                long long power = 1;
                while (exp > 0) {
                    if (exp & 1) power = (power * base) % M;
                    base = (base * base) % M;
                    exp >>= 1;
                }
                ans = (ans * power) % M;
            }
        }

        cout << ans << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
